_doc: Caps enforced by engine/labcore.py. Exceeding a cap moves the job to ESCALATED (infra caps move it to BLOCKED). Per-cycle caps (revisions, fix_attempts, infra_retries, agent_calls_per_job) reset on resume and some on reject; the lifetime caps (lifetime_agent_calls, lifetime_revisions, lifetime_resumes, input_rounds, repairs) never reset. A resume past lifetime_resumes is refused: cancel, or start a new job with --continue-from. fix_attempts caps the fix_with loop after a failed script stage; fanout_max caps any fanout item list; repairs caps the one-re-ask-per-call repair retries (invalid output, severity directive).
